speaker: YOU
text: Wait—what’s happening to you?

speaker: YOU
text: Hey… easy, boy. Easy.

speaker: YOU
text: The keeper warned me about this. Embers… find the embers.

speaker: YOU
text: Easy… it’s over. You’re safe now.

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: The embers are home, and the curse is broken. He’s free.

speaker: YOU
text: How did this even happen to him?

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: No accident. The Triad put that curse in him years ago. The shrine saw it all. Watch.

speaker: YOU
text: The bridges out there are all broken. What happened to the living road?

speaker: IVEN
text: The Dark Triad. They came one night and cut every crossing. By morning, Clover was split in two.

speaker: IVEN
text: The Stormleaf Scar saw it all. It never forgets. See for yourself.

speaker: IVEN
text: Now you know. Three gaps are left, and each one has a guide.

speaker: IVEN
text: While calm, turn the guide toward the gold leaf. Then stir chaos, and the roots will grow.

speaker: IVEN
text: At the end is the Stormleaf Scar. It still remembers which spells are real.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Once, the living road carried all of Clover across the ravine.

speaker: IVEN
text: Grow true, little guide. They will cross you for a hundred years.

speaker: VEYR
text: Clover’s magic runs through these roots. Cut them, and it’s ours.

speaker: SILE
text: Ooh, there’s so much of it!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: His chains drained the roots dry, and the leaves turned to ash.

speaker: IVEN
text: Off the road! Everyone, to the Archive!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One by one, the crossings fell.

speaker: VEYR
text: Scatter fake spells among the real ones. Whoever comes after us will chase the wrong one.

speaker: IVEN
text: Then the Scar keeps the true pattern. Only a calm heart will read it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The road can grow again. The Scar still holds the true pattern.

speaker: IVEN
text: There. That’s the road as it was, before they cut it.

speaker: YOU
text: And the red marks?

speaker: IVEN
text: Veyr’s fakes. They’re gone now. What’s left are the real spells guarding the Hollow Crown. The Root Sigil will remember them for you.

speaker: IVEN
text: My chest is above the clouds. Climb Clover Terraces to the gateway at the top.

speaker: IVEN
text: In the Sky Garden, follow the Starlight Ledges up to the highest one.

speaker: IVEN
text: If you’re reading this, the Scar trusted you. This hook came from Heart, long ago.

speaker: IVEN
text: It only bites into glowing crystal. Nothing else will hold it.

speaker: IVEN
text: Past the clouds is Heart. The Triad stole its water magic. Find Sera, she’s been fighting them alone.

speaker: YOU
text: Heart it is. Time to find Sera.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Years ago, a stray dog slept every night at the foot of the Grimoire Tower.

speaker: VEYR
text: That dog goes everywhere. Curse it, and our curse goes everywhere too.

speaker: SILE
text: Ooh, a warm little shrine. Mine now.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Split it in three. When it wakes, the pieces scatter.

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: Get away from that dog!

speaker: VEYR
text: Too late, old woman. The first time someone runs wild beside it, it burns.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The curse slept for years. Then you came along and ran wild.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Three embers, one curse, and the Triad behind it all.

speaker: YOU
text: They did this to a dog. Who else have they hurt?

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: Plenty. West of here is the Spade Kingdom. Veyr turned the people who stood up to him into wisps.

speaker: YOU
text: Is anyone helping them?

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: A woman named Neris. Her house is the Lantern Refuge, the first one on your right past Spade’s gate.

speaker: YOU
text: And him?

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: He stays with me. The curse is gone, but he needs rest. Spade is no place for him yet.

speaker: YOU
text: Look after him. I’ll come back when the Triad is finished.

speaker: NERIS
text: The anchor is broken. The castle doors are open now.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Go into the castle. Take the stairs on the left up to the archive, and read the three records while calm.

speaker: NIM
text: This shell shows me Heart. That’s happening right now.

speaker: NIM
text: An earthquake! The ground near Sera’s springs is tearing open.

speaker: NIM
text: The land… it’s lifting into the sky!

speaker: SERA
text: Traveller, if you have the Tide Hook, come quickly. It’s the only way up there.
direction: distant, urgent, filtered as through water

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The ground shudders under the gate.

speaker: SERA
text: Earthquake! Hold on, traveller. The springs are tearing open!

speaker: SERA
text: I’m Sera, keeper of Heart’s springs. The land has lifted into the sky, and your Tide Hook is the only way up. Find me by the gate.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A season ago, Heart’s water rose from three springs on the reef and filled every canal in Tidewell.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Sera looked after the springs. Queen Elowen looked after the town.

speaker: SILE
text: Such a generous kingdom. It won’t miss a little water.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Her siphon was built in Diamond. It drained all three springs dry.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One by one, the canals emptied and the mills stopped turning.

speaker: SERA
text: Hide, little spirit. Sleep in the stone until someone comes to wake you.

speaker: QUEEN ELOWEN
text: Give back what you took from my people!

speaker: MORCANT
text: The queen wants the siphon? Then she can go down with it.

speaker: VEYR
text: Chain the reef. If anyone comes for the siphon, it tears itself out of the ground and carries it into the sky.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The moment you took the Tide Hook, Veyr’s chains pulled. That was the earthquake you saw.

speaker: SERA
text: Now you have seen it. The siphon is still down there, under the risen reef. So is our queen.

speaker: SERA
text: My water spirit slept in the Listening isle. The quake woke it. Guide it from spring to spring and it will find the siphon.

speaker: SERA
text: Hold Q at the floating crystals to swing up to the islands. Raise the crystal bridges in chaos, and guide the spirit in calm.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Diamond mines the crystal that powers every kingdom’s magic.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The workers dig it here, in the pit, under the royals’ watchtowers.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: They live down here, in the dust. The Triad keeps their families in a stockade.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every crystal is weighed and taken, then hauled up the causeway.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: One road leads up, over the royals’ drawbridge.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Up there the royals keep the Great Prism, and the Triad holds the crown.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Find Artificer Orin by the relay at the bottom of the quarry.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The pulse leaves the escape gate and runs along the buried conduit.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The Triad’s seal breaks. The chains fall.

speaker: ORIN
text: They’re free. Every family in that stockade is free.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The core’s light reaches the Citadel. The Triad’s hold on the crown is broken.

speaker: ORIN
text: Come back to me in the quarry.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Before the Triad came, Diamond’s artificers built the Shatterglass Relay here.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Chains. One for every family in the stockade.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Forge them, or they wear them.

speaker: ORIN
text: …We will forge them.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: When he had gone, a worker scratched a message into one of the relay’s pipes.

speaker: WORKER
text: “They forced us to make the chains. Don’t blame Diamond.”

speaker: ORIN
text: Break the relay. Hide the pieces in our workshops. The Triad will never use it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The relay stayed broken until someone came who could mend it.

speaker: ORIN
text: That pipe you found in Heart was ours. Now you know who scratched the message into it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: It shows where the Triad’s armour draws its power, so it can be cut.

speaker: ORIN
text: You carry all four sigils now. Sile will come for that light. When she’s done, go back to Spade.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Heart bowed. Its queen bowed. You took Heart’s sigil, insect, so I took you.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Kneel, insect. The Bone God is in a generous mood.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Enough. Behold the armour of a god!

speaker: MORCANT
text: You dare scorch the throne of bone?

speaker: MORCANT
text: Burn all you like, insect. A god’s bones always grow back.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Impossible. I let you have that. Remember it.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Keep your little kingdom, for now. Elowen stays mine, beyond the Hollow Gate.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Burn me, then. Sile will drink your little fires.

speaker: SERA
text: Magic feeds them. Steel that remembers the Accord does not.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Is this all Heart could send me?

speaker: MORCANT
text: Why must a god swat every fly that buzzes at his throne?

speaker: MORCANT
text: I ruled Heart before your grandmother drew breath.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Stay down. It suits you.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Gods do not sweat for insects.

speaker: MORCANT
text: A scratch. Gods do not bleed.

speaker: MORCANT
text: You will pay for that, worm.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Lucky. Only lucky.

speaker: MORCANT
text: Do you know who I am?

speaker: SILE
text: Ooh, the sprout that sent Morcant crawling home. Gimme that sigil. My turn!

speaker: SILE
text: Come on, little sprout. Let's play!

speaker: SILE
text: Ha! Too slow, sprout! Up here!

speaker: SILE
text: Hey! That hurt!

speaker: SILE
text: No, no, no, that's MY power!

speaker: SILE
text: Ugh... you broke my toy.

speaker: SILE
text: Jump, little sprout! Jump!

speaker: SILE
text: Stop that! Those are MINE!

speaker: SILE
text: Hehe... mine again.

speaker: SILE
text: Ha! Your spells are mine now! Did Morcant not warn you? Keep throwing!

speaker: SILE
text: Not fun... Next time, Veyr plays too.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The cured hound breathed on the book, and the first page filled with wind. Throw it, and a gale knocks enemies back.

speaker: SHRINE KEEPER
text: This is the Grimoire. The Triad tore out its pages. Every page you bring back gives you a new spell.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Spade gave its last light freely. Light given freely burns the hottest, and now it burns for you.

speaker: NERIS
text: Our people kept this light alive for you. Burn the dark with it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The roots that grew the Living Road now grow for you. Call on them, and a wall of stone rises to protect you.

speaker: IVEN
text: You gave the road back its roots. Now let them stand between you and the Triad.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Heart’s stolen current flows free again, and it wraps around you as a shield of living water.

speaker: SERA
text: The springs answer you now. Let the water guard you.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Light that enters a prism leaves as many colours. This page teaches the four spells to do the same.

speaker: ORIN
text: Light through a prism is never only one colour. Neither is your magic now.

speaker: SILE
text: [cackles loudly] Ahahahaha! Ahaha!

speaker: SILE
text: [giggles smugly] Hehe!

speaker: SILE
text: [annoyed, forced laugh] Hmph. Ha... ha.
